# Tes

> > Tes is a comprehensive education platform combining teaching jobs, school management software, safeguarding tools, and educational resources for schools worldwide.

Tes serves educators and school administrators globally with an integrated suite of products spanning recruitment, classroom management, safeguarding compliance, and student learning. The platform supports both UK and international schools with specialized tools for school administration, staff management, and child protection.

## Key Topics

- School Software
- School Management
- Safeguarding
- Teaching Jobs
- Classroom Management
- Parent Communication
- Staff Management
- Child Protection
- School Administration
- Teacher Scheduling
- CPD Training
- International Schools
- Parent Engagement
- Education Platform
- Safeguarding Training

## Core Platform & Services

- [Tes - Education Jobs, Teaching Resources, School Software & Magazine](https://www.tes.com): Tes homepage: education platform for teaching jobs, resources, school software
- [School Software Services, Tools & Products | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools): Tes school software suite: recruitment, staff management, safeguarding tools
- [Teaching Jobs & Education Jobs - Tes Jobs](https://www.tes.com/jobs): Tes Jobs: UK and international teaching job search and applications

## School Management & Administration Software

- [Tes Engage – School management information system (MIS) | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/engage): Tes Engage: comprehensive school MIS for administration and parent engagement
- [Tes Class Charts | Classroom Management Software | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/class-charts): Class Charts: classroom management software for seating plans and behavior tracking
- [Tes Timetable | School Timetable Software | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/timetabling-edval): Tes Timetable: school scheduling software for complex pupil and teacher timetables
- [Tes Room Booking | School room booking system | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/room-booking): Tes Room Booking: school resource and room management system
- [Tes AssetWhere | School asset management software](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/assetwhere): Tes AssetWhere: school asset and facilities management software

## Safeguarding & Child Protection

- [Tes MyConcern | School Safeguarding Software | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/myconcern): Tes MyConcern: safeguarding software for child protection and concern management
- [Tes Safeguarding Training | Safeguarding Training for school staff | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/safeguarding-training): Tes Safeguarding Training: 40+ CPD courses for school staff compliance
- [Tes Clarity safeguarding reporting tool for trusts | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/clarity): Tes Clarity: safeguarding reporting dashboard for trusts and local authorities

## Parent Communication & Student Learning

- [Tes Parents' Meetings | Parents evening system | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/parents-meetings): Tes Parents' Meetings: online and in-person parents evening system
- [Tes Learning Pathways | Learning plans | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/learning-pathways): Tes Learning Pathways: platform for personalized learning plans and student progress
- [Tes Clubs and Events | School booking system | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/clubs-and-events): Tes Clubs and Events: extracurricular booking and payment tracking system
